title: FinanceBench holdout-60 prompt-control infrastructure incident

arms.first_error: planner_request_failed: chat failed (503): auth_unavailable for provider codex and model gpt-5.4-mini

diagnosis.proxy_observation: One 408 was followed by 44 concurrent 503 responses within the same logged second; CLIProxy reported no auth available for gpt-5.4-mini.
diagnosis.credential_file: present, not disabled, and not expired
diagnosis.classification: model-route infrastructure failure, not task/model outcome

recovery.action: Restarted the existing local CLIProxyAPI service to reload the credential pool and clear in-memory unavailability state.

analysis_policy: No accuracy or paired comparison from this matrix is reportable. Retain all artifacts as an incident. Start a complete four-arm replication after recovery; do not selectively rerun the affected arm.
